qualities.name: Supernatural haunting
qualities.match_rule: A ghost or haunting causes danger, fear or disturbance in the story.
qualities.not_sufficient: A ghost costume, a title or a metaphor for a troubled past does not establish a haunting.

qualities.name: Possession horror
qualities.match_rule: An invading entity takes control of a person's body or actions.
qualities.not_sufficient: Unusual behaviour, hallucination or replacement by a separate duplicate does not by itself establish invading control.

qualities.name: Psychological horror
qualities.match_rule: Mental disturbance, unreliable perception or internal psychological conflict is a source of the film's horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: Fear caused by a known external danger alone does not establish a psychological horror mechanism.

qualities.name: Body horror
qualities.match_rule: Bodily violation, mutation or loss of bodily integrity is presented as a source of horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: An injury mentioned in a synopsis or the mere appearance of a creature does not establish horror about bodily integrity.

qualities.name: Folk horror
qualities.match_rule: Folk beliefs, local traditions or community rituals are a source of horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: A rural setting alone does not establish folk horror. Invented folklore need not be an authentic historical practice.

qualities.name: Cosmic horror
qualities.match_rule: An incomprehensible nonhuman reality threatens human significance, knowledge or identity.
qualities.not_sufficient: A god, monster, alien or global danger alone does not establish incomprehensibility or human insignificance.

qualities.name: Slasher horror
qualities.match_rule: A killer repeatedly stalks and attacks a succession of victims.
qualities.not_sufficient: One attack or a murder without stalking a succession of victims does not establish this pattern.

qualities.name: Creature feature
qualities.match_rule: A nonhuman creature poses a physical threat in the story.
qualities.not_sufficient: A harmless creature, a metaphor or a creature mentioned only in a title does not establish the physical threat.

qualities.name: Zombie horror
qualities.match_rule: Reanimated or zombie-like humans threaten people in the story.
qualities.not_sufficient: A dead body alone or a figurative description of someone as a zombie does not establish a zombie threat.

qualities.name: Vampire horror
qualities.match_rule: Vampirism is a source of danger or horror in the story.
qualities.not_sufficient: Blood loss or a vampire reference alone does not establish a vampiric threat.

qualities.name: Werewolf horror
qualities.match_rule: A human transforms into a wolf-like predator that is a source of danger or horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: A wolf attack or a comparison with a wolf does not establish human transformation.

qualities.name: Witchcraft horror
qualities.match_rule: Witches or deliberate magical practice cause danger or horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: An accusation of witchcraft without supported magical practice or a witch threat does not establish this mechanism.

qualities.name: Occult horror
qualities.match_rule: Hidden supernatural knowledge or esoteric practice is involved in the film's threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: A secret with no supernatural or esoteric connection does not establish occult horror.

qualities.name: Religious horror
qualities.match_rule: Sacred beliefs, religious evil or spiritual conflict are a source of horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: Religious clothing, a building or a character's affiliation alone does not establish religious horror.

qualities.name: Science-fiction horror
qualities.match_rule: A scientific or extraterrestrial premise produces danger or horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: A scientist's presence or ordinary technology alone does not establish a science-fiction premise.

qualities.name: Ecological horror
qualities.match_rule: Ecological disturbance or a hostile natural world produces danger or horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: An outdoor setting alone does not establish ecological horror.

qualities.name: Survival horror
qualities.match_rule: Characters struggle to stay alive against an immediate lethal threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: A reference to possible death without a depicted struggle to survive does not establish survival horror.

qualities.name: Home-invasion horror
qualities.match_rule: Intruders enter a domestic refuge and threaten its occupants.
qualities.not_sufficient: A threat outside a home or an invited visitor with no threatening intrusion does not establish home invasion.

qualities.name: Revenge horror
qualities.match_rule: Retaliation for an earlier wrong causes threatening or horrific actions.
qualities.not_sufficient: Unrelated violence after an earlier wrong does not establish retaliation.

qualities.name: Horror comedy
qualities.match_rule: The film combines horror with comic treatment or situations.
qualities.not_sufficient: A character smiling or an isolated quoted joke without comic treatment of the film's events does not establish horror comedy.

qualities.name: Gothic horror
qualities.match_rule: Decay, haunted histories or Gothic spaces and sensibilities contribute to the film's horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: An old building alone does not establish a Gothic treatment.

qualities.name: Found-footage horror
qualities.match_rule: Recordings presented as recovered or discovered material form part of the film's storytelling.
qualities.not_sufficient: A recording played as an ordinary prop does not establish a recovered-footage presentation.

qualities.name: Screenlife horror
qualities.match_rule: Events are presented to the audience through computer or phone interfaces.
qualities.not_sufficient: Characters using devices in ordinary camera shots does not establish interface-based presentation.

qualities.name: Anthology horror
qualities.match_rule: The film is composed of several distinct horror stories.
qualities.not_sufficient: A backstory, flashback or change of viewpoint within one story does not alone establish an anthology.

qualities.name: Backwoods horror
qualities.match_rule: An isolated rural or backcountry environment exposes characters to the film's threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: A brief journey through countryside without a connection to the threat does not establish this setting mechanism.

qualities.name: Urban horror
qualities.match_rule: Conditions or social spaces of city life contribute to the film's horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: A city address alone does not establish a connection between urban life and the horror.

qualities.name: Apocalyptic horror
qualities.match_rule: Societal collapse or a world-ending catastrophe is depicted or described within the story.
qualities.not_sufficient: A local disaster alone does not establish societal collapse or a world-ending threat.

qualities.name: Epidemic horror
qualities.match_rule: Disease or infection spreads through a population and creates danger.
qualities.not_sufficient: One infected person without spread or an established outbreak does not establish an epidemic.

qualities.name: Erotic horror
qualities.match_rule: Sexual desire is linked to the film's horror or danger.
qualities.not_sufficient: Nudity or an intimate relationship alone does not establish the desire-horror connection.

qualities.name: Medical horror
qualities.match_rule: Medical treatment, institutions or experimentation produce danger or horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: A hospital location or a doctor's presence alone does not establish medical horror.

qualities.name: Remote isolation
qualities.match_rule: Distance from assistance limits characters' ability to obtain help against danger.
qualities.not_sufficient: A remote place name alone does not establish difficulty obtaining help.

qualities.name: Confining interiors
qualities.match_rule: Enclosed indoor spaces limit escape or action.
qualities.not_sufficient: An indoor scene alone does not establish restricted escape or movement.

qualities.name: Ritual survival rules
qualities.match_rule: Following specified ritual rules enables characters to navigate or survive a threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: A ritual performed without survival conditions or consequences does not establish survival rules.

qualities.name: Bargain with an entity
qualities.match_rule: A negotiated exchange with a supernatural being has terms that affect the participants.
qualities.not_sufficient: An offering without an exchange or agreement does not establish a bargain.

qualities.name: Secret cult
qualities.match_rule: An organised hidden group serves a dangerous belief or entity.
qualities.not_sufficient: Secrecy or conspiracy alone does not establish a shared cultic belief or devotion.

qualities.name: Doppelganger
qualities.match_rule: A double or imitation of a person creates danger or uncertainty.
qualities.not_sufficient: A resemblance with no identity-double role does not establish a doppelganger.

qualities.name: Concealed infection
qualities.match_rule: An infected or assimilated person's condition is hidden from others.
qualities.not_sufficient: A known infection or an unrelated secret does not establish concealed infection.

qualities.name: Corrupted child
qualities.match_rule: A child becomes a threatening agent through corruption or supernatural influence.
qualities.not_sufficient: A child in danger or a malicious adult described as childlike does not establish a corrupted child.

qualities.name: Inherited curse
qualities.match_rule: A supernatural affliction passes through a family or lineage.
qualities.not_sufficient: A family misfortune without a supernatural transmission does not establish an inherited curse.

qualities.name: Hostile landscape
qualities.match_rule: Terrain or environmental conditions increase the danger faced by characters.
qualities.not_sufficient: A landscape description without an adverse effect on characters does not establish a hostile landscape.

qualities.name: Stalking pursuit
qualities.match_rule: A predator repeatedly follows or hunts a particular target.
qualities.not_sufficient: One unexpected attack without following or hunting does not establish stalking pursuit.

qualities.name: Contagious curse
qualities.match_rule: A supernatural threat passes between people through a described mechanism.
qualities.not_sufficient: An ordinary infection or several unrelated supernatural attacks do not establish curse transmission.

qualities.name: Last survivor
qualities.match_rule: Only one member of the threatened group is left alive in the story's stated outcome.
qualities.not_sufficient: A source mentioning one survivor without establishing the fate of the rest does not establish a last survivor.

qualities.name: Siege
qualities.match_rule: An opposing force surrounds or contains people in a location they defend.
qualities.not_sufficient: Confinement without a besieging force or a defended position does not establish a siege.

qualities.name: Grotesque transformation
qualities.match_rule: A body is shown or described changing into a grotesque form.
qualities.not_sufficient: A pre-existing unusual appearance without transformation does not establish grotesque transformation.

qualities.name: Slow-burn pacing
qualities.match_rule: The completed film's pacing is described as gradual or slow-building.
qualities.not_sufficient: Chronological escalation, a decades-long plot or a long rough cut does not establish slow screen pacing.

qualities.name: Relentless pacing
qualities.match_rule: The completed film's pacing is described as rapid or unremitting.
qualities.not_sufficient: Many plot events or a high body count alone do not establish rapid or unremitting screen pacing.

qualities.name: Investigation-led narrative
qualities.match_rule: Characters' systematic investigation moves the story forward.
qualities.not_sufficient: A single question or accidental discovery without investigation does not establish an investigation-led narrative.

qualities.name: Whodunit structure
qualities.match_rule: The narrative presents a mystery about which person committed a crime.
qualities.not_sufficient: A known perpetrator or a mystery about a non-criminal event does not establish a whodunit.

qualities.name: Hidden-identity mystery
qualities.match_rule: Suspense concerns who or what a character really is.
qualities.not_sufficient: A hidden name without identity-related suspense does not establish a hidden-identity mystery.

qualities.name: Unreliable narration
qualities.match_rule: A narrator's account of events is misleading or unreliable.
qualities.not_sufficient: A character who lacks information without misleading narration does not establish an unreliable narrator.

qualities.name: Uncertain perception
qualities.match_rule: A viewpoint character sees or hears events whose occurrence or accuracy is called into question.
qualities.not_sufficient: Uncertainty about another person's identity, motive or danger without unreliable seeing or hearing does not establish uncertain perception.

qualities.name: Nonlinear chronology
qualities.match_rule: The film presents events out of chronological order.
qualities.not_sufficient: A synopsis retelling events out of order or a character recalling something without a presented time shift does not establish nonlinear chronology.

qualities.name: Time loop
qualities.match_rule: Characters experience a literal repeated period of time.
qualities.not_sufficient: Similar events on different days without literal temporal repetition do not establish a time loop.

qualities.name: Repeated ordeal
qualities.match_rule: A similar dangerous procedure or ordeal recurs with variations.
qualities.not_sufficient: Several unrelated dangers or one ordeal lasting a long time do not establish a repeated ordeal.

qualities.name: Dramatic irony
qualities.match_rule: The audience is given information relevant to a character's situation that the character lacks.
qualities.not_sufficient: Characters knowing different things does not establish that the audience knows more than the affected character.

qualities.name: Restricted viewpoint
qualities.match_rule: The audience's access to events and information is limited to one character's experience.
qualities.not_sufficient: Having one protagonist alone does not establish restricted presentation of information.

qualities.name: Alternating viewpoints
qualities.match_rule: The narrative alternates among different characters' perspectives.
qualities.not_sufficient: A conversation or a camera cut between speakers alone does not establish alternating narrative viewpoints.

qualities.name: Concealed monster
qualities.match_rule: The film withholds the threat's physical form before revealing it or keeping it unseen.
qualities.not_sufficient: A synopsis omitting the creature's appearance does not establish that the film conceals it.

qualities.name: Delayed explanation
qualities.match_rule: The narrative postpones an explanation of events that it has presented as unexplained.
qualities.not_sufficient: A synopsis explaining events late does not establish that the film delays the explanation.

qualities.name: Unexplained mechanism
qualities.match_rule: The mechanism of a threat is left unexplained by the film.
qualities.not_sufficient: A source omitting an explanation does not establish that the completed film leaves it unexplained.

qualities.name: Identity-revelation twist
qualities.match_rule: An identity revelation changes how earlier events are understood.
qualities.not_sufficient: An identity disclosed without revising the interpretation of earlier events does not establish an identity-revelation twist.

qualities.name: Perspective-reversal twist
qualities.match_rule: A revelation changes which account or perspective earlier events are understood through.
qualities.not_sufficient: New information that only continues the story without changing its earlier interpretation does not establish a perspective reversal.

qualities.name: False ending
qualities.match_rule: An apparent conclusion is followed by renewed threat or a reversal that reopens the story.
qualities.not_sufficient: A further scene after a conclusion without renewed threat or reversal does not establish a false ending.

qualities.name: Real-time structure
qualities.match_rule: The film's presented action unfolds approximately continuously in real time.
qualities.not_sufficient: A short story duration or a synopsis without time markers does not establish real-time presentation.

qualities.name: Grief and bereavement
qualities.match_rule: The film portrays mourning or other responses to the loss of a loved one.
qualities.not_sufficient: A death without a portrayed response to bereavement does not establish grief.

qualities.name: Ambivalence about motherhood
qualities.match_rule: Motherhood is portrayed through conflicting feelings or demands.
qualities.not_sufficient: A mother facing danger without conflicting feelings or demands about motherhood does not establish ambivalence.

qualities.name: Paternal legacy
qualities.match_rule: A father's values or actions influence the next generation's choices.
qualities.not_sufficient: A father's presence without an effect on the next generation does not establish paternal legacy.

qualities.name: Trauma and its aftermath
qualities.match_rule: The film portrays continuing effects of a traumatic experience.
qualities.not_sufficient: A harmful event without its subsequent effects does not establish trauma's aftermath.

qualities.name: Greed and corruption
qualities.match_rule: Desire for wealth or possessions leads to wrongdoing or moral compromise.
qualities.not_sufficient: Wealth, poverty or wanting something without acquisitive desire leading to corruption does not establish this quality.

qualities.name: Class inequality
qualities.match_rule: Unequal social or economic position affects characters' opportunities, treatment or conflict.
qualities.not_sufficient: Different incomes alone without depicted consequences do not establish class inequality as used here.

qualities.name: Labour exploitation
qualities.match_rule: Workers are exploited through their labour, conditions or compensation.
qualities.not_sufficient: Work or an employer's presence alone does not establish labour exploitation.

qualities.name: Institutional neglect
qualities.match_rule: An institution fails to provide protection or care to people for whom it has responsibility.
qualities.not_sufficient: An unaffiliated person's failure alone does not establish institutional neglect.

qualities.name: Distrust of authority
qualities.match_rule: Characters or the film's account question the legitimacy, honesty or reliability of an authority.
qualities.not_sufficient: An authority figure's appearance alone does not establish distrust.

qualities.name: Faith and doubt
qualities.match_rule: The film portrays uncertainty or conflict concerning religious or spiritual belief.
qualities.not_sufficient: Distrust of another person's identity or honesty alone does not establish spiritual faith and doubt.

qualities.name: Religious guilt
qualities.match_rule: A character experiences guilt connected to religious teaching or practice.
qualities.not_sufficient: Religious affiliation or guilt without a religious connection does not establish religious guilt.

qualities.name: Loss of self
qualities.match_rule: A person's identity is eroded, displaced or replaced.
qualities.not_sufficient: Disguise or concealment of an otherwise intact identity alone does not establish loss of self.

qualities.name: Bodily autonomy
qualities.match_rule: A person's control over their own body is threatened or contested.
qualities.not_sufficient: A bodily injury without a question of control or consent does not alone establish bodily autonomy.

qualities.name: Mortality and ageing
qualities.match_rule: The film portrays ageing or characters confronting the inevitability of death.
qualities.not_sufficient: A death alone does not establish reflection on mortality or ageing.

qualities.name: Illness and vulnerability
qualities.match_rule: Illness creates vulnerability or affects a character's experience.
qualities.not_sufficient: An illness label without effects on a character does not establish illness-related vulnerability.

qualities.name: Addiction and dependency
qualities.match_rule: A character's compulsive dependency produces effects on their choices, relationships or wellbeing.
qualities.not_sufficient: Use of a substance or a habit without compulsive dependency does not establish addiction.

qualities.name: Sexual repression
qualities.match_rule: Sexual desire is suppressed, denied or constrained.
qualities.not_sufficient: Lack of sexual activity without suppression or denial does not establish sexual repression.

qualities.name: Gender expectations
qualities.match_rule: Expectations about gender roles shape how characters are treated or expected to behave.
qualities.not_sufficient: A character's gender alone does not establish gender-role expectations.

qualities.name: Queer identity
qualities.match_rule: The film portrays queer identity or its social treatment.
qualities.not_sufficient: A performer or filmmaker's identity, or later queer-icon status, alone does not establish queer identity within the story.

qualities.name: Racial othering
qualities.match_rule: People are excluded, stereotyped or dehumanised on racial grounds.
qualities.not_sufficient: Different racial identities alone do not establish racial othering.

qualities.name: Colonial violence
qualities.match_rule: The film portrays colonial domination or effects of its legacy.
qualities.not_sufficient: A period setting alone does not establish colonial violence or its legacy.

qualities.name: Guilt and responsibility
qualities.match_rule: Characters confront responsibility or guilt for harm they have caused or allowed.
qualities.not_sufficient: Distress without guilt or responsibility for harm does not establish this quality.

qualities.name: Complicity
qualities.match_rule: Characters participate in, enable or benefit from others' wrongdoing.
qualities.not_sufficient: Witnessing harm without participation, enabling or benefit does not establish complicity.

qualities.name: Inherited harm
qualities.match_rule: Earlier generations' harmful actions have consequences for later generations.
qualities.not_sufficient: A family resemblance or inherited property alone does not establish inherited harm.

qualities.name: Family secrets
qualities.match_rule: Concealed family history affects relationships, choices or conflict.
qualities.not_sufficient: An unrelated secret or openly known family history does not establish a family secret.

qualities.name: Conformity and dissent
qualities.match_rule: Characters face pressure to conform or consequences for resisting group expectations.
qualities.not_sufficient: Simple agreement without pressure or dissent does not establish conformity and dissent.

qualities.name: Social alienation
qualities.match_rule: A character experiences estrangement from a social group or society.
qualities.not_sufficient: Physical distance alone does not establish social alienation.

qualities.name: Nature resisting exploitation
qualities.match_rule: The natural world is represented as reacting against human exploitation.
qualities.not_sufficient: Environmental danger without a connection to human exploitation does not establish nature resisting exploitation.

qualities.name: Scientific ethics
qualities.match_rule: The film raises ethical questions about scientific inquiry or experimentation.
qualities.not_sufficient: A laboratory or scientist without an ethical conflict does not establish scientific ethics.

qualities.name: Technological anxiety
qualities.match_rule: Technology is associated with fear, loss of control or danger in the film.
qualities.not_sufficient: A device's presence without a threatening or anxious connection does not establish technological anxiety.

qualities.name: Uncertain reality
qualities.match_rule: The film questions whether experienced reality is false or unstable.
qualities.not_sufficient: An unknown motive or concealed identity alone does not establish unstable reality.

qualities.name: Consumer culture
qualities.match_rule: The film examines consumption, commodification or consumer values.
qualities.not_sufficient: Shopping, products or wealth appearing without commentary on consumption or commodification does not establish this quality.

qualities.name: Destructive ambition
qualities.match_rule: Pursuit of status or achievement causes moral or personal damage.
qualities.not_sufficient: Having an ambition without damage caused by its pursuit does not establish destructive ambition.

qualities.name: Free will and control
qualities.match_rule: The film questions whether characters can choose or control their actions.
qualities.not_sufficient: An obstacle to a goal without a question of choice or control does not establish free will and control.

qualities.name: Dehumanisation
qualities.match_rule: People are treated or represented as less than human.
qualities.not_sufficient: A nonhuman character's presence alone does not establish dehumanisation of people.

qualities.name: Protector becomes threat
qualities.match_rule: A person or force expected to protect someone instead becomes a source of danger to them.
qualities.not_sufficient: An unrelated attacker with no prior protective role does not establish protector becomes threat.

qualities.name: Sanctuary becomes trap
qualities.match_rule: A place sought as protection instead confines people with a threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: A dangerous location never sought as refuge does not establish sanctuary becomes trap.

qualities.name: Survival spreads danger
qualities.match_rule: An action that preserves someone's life spreads a threat to others.
qualities.not_sufficient: Survival followed by unrelated harm does not establish survival spreading danger.

qualities.name: Defeating evil creates evil
qualities.match_rule: An attempt to defeat a threat creates a new threatening evil.
qualities.not_sufficient: A later unrelated threat or the original threat surviving does not establish this causal creation.

qualities.name: Desired reward causes ruin
qualities.match_rule: Obtaining or pursuing a desired reward brings about a character's downfall.
qualities.not_sufficient: A reward and later misfortune without a causal link do not establish this reversal.

qualities.name: Knowledge increases vulnerability
qualities.match_rule: Learning sought information makes the learner more vulnerable.
qualities.not_sufficient: Learning about existing danger without increasing vulnerability does not establish this reversal.

qualities.name: Denial enables harm
qualities.match_rule: Refusal to acknowledge danger enables further harm.
qualities.not_sufficient: A mistaken belief without refusal or a connection to further harm does not establish denial enabling harm.

qualities.name: Loyalty protects the predator
qualities.match_rule: Loyalty to an apparent ally shields a threatening antagonist.
qualities.not_sufficient: An antagonist escaping without protection arising from loyalty does not establish this reversal.

qualities.name: Suspicion harms the innocent
qualities.match_rule: Suspicion of a threat causes harm to someone not established as that threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: Suspicion without harm or harm to an established threat does not establish this quality.

qualities.name: Cruelty undermines survival
qualities.match_rule: Cruel treatment of others damages the cruel character's or group's ability to survive.
qualities.not_sufficient: Cruelty and later danger without a causal relation do not establish this reversal.

qualities.name: Compassion breaks the threat's hold
qualities.match_rule: Care or compassion weakens a threat's hold over someone.
qualities.not_sufficient: Compassion accompanying a rescue without weakening the threat does not establish this mechanism.

qualities.name: Monster shows greater humanity
qualities.match_rule: A monster demonstrates more compassion or moral consideration than a human counterpart.
qualities.not_sufficient: A sympathetic monster without a comparison in treatment does not establish greater humanity than a human counterpart.

qualities.name: Respectability conceals evil
qualities.match_rule: A socially respectable appearance or role conceals wrongdoing or monstrosity.
qualities.not_sufficient: A respectable character who is openly known as dangerous does not establish concealment by respectability.

qualities.name: Innocence conceals malice
qualities.match_rule: An apparently innocent person is revealed as deliberately malicious.
qualities.not_sufficient: A person causing accidental harm or being falsely accused does not establish concealed malice.

qualities.name: Cure worsens the affliction
qualities.match_rule: An intended cure makes the underlying affliction worse.
qualities.not_sufficient: A failed cure leaving the condition unchanged does not establish worsening.

qualities.name: Repression strengthens the threat
qualities.match_rule: Suppressing an experience or feeling strengthens the threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: Repression and a growing threat without a causal link do not establish this mechanism.

qualities.name: Control produces chaos
qualities.match_rule: An effort to establish control makes events more uncontrollable.
qualities.not_sufficient: An unsuccessful attempt at control without increased disorder does not establish this reversal.

qualities.name: Victory conceals defeat
qualities.match_rule: An apparent victory is revealed to include a defeat or loss.
qualities.not_sufficient: An openly partial victory without a concealed defeat does not establish this reversal.

qualities.name: Selfish character makes a sacrifice
qualities.match_rule: A character established as selfish later makes a self-sacrifice.
qualities.not_sufficient: A helpful act without personal sacrifice or an earlier selfish portrayal does not establish this reversal.

qualities.name: Escape perpetuates the cycle
qualities.match_rule: Escape from immediate danger continues a harmful cycle for others.
qualities.not_sufficient: A threat merely remaining alive under containment does not establish that escape perpetuates a cycle.

qualities.name: Mistrust within a group
qualities.match_rule: Apparent allies suspect or distrust each other in their interactions.
qualities.not_sufficient: Lack of knowledge without suspicion among allies does not establish group mistrust.

qualities.name: Caretaker dependency
qualities.match_rule: A dependent person's needs constrain a caregiver's choices or relationship.
qualities.not_sufficient: A caregiver title without a depicted dependency affecting choices does not establish caretaker dependency.

qualities.name: Strained parent-child relationship
qualities.match_rule: Conflict or resentment strains a parent-child relationship.
qualities.not_sufficient: A parent and child appearing together without relationship strain does not establish this quality.

qualities.name: Overprotective care
qualities.match_rule: A caregiver's excessive protection constrains or harms the person being protected.
qualities.not_sufficient: Protection without restrictive or harmful excess does not establish overprotective care.

qualities.name: Intimate betrayal
qualities.match_rule: A trusted intimate partner or close confidant betrays that trust.
qualities.not_sufficient: An enemy's attack without an intimate or confiding bond does not establish intimate betrayal.

qualities.name: Coercive partnership
qualities.match_rule: A partner uses coercion or abuse to control the other person's choices.
qualities.not_sufficient: Ordinary disagreement without coercion or abuse does not establish a coercive partnership.

qualities.name: Sibling rivalry
qualities.match_rule: Siblings compete with or resent each other.
qualities.not_sufficient: Sibling presence or disagreement unrelated to rivalry does not establish sibling rivalry.

qualities.name: Divided loyalty
qualities.match_rule: A character faces conflicting loyalties to different people or groups.
qualities.not_sufficient: Several loyalties without a conflict between them do not establish divided loyalty.

qualities.name: Chosen-family solidarity
qualities.match_rule: A non-biological group develops family-like mutual care under pressure.
qualities.not_sufficient: Temporary tactical cooperation without family-like attachment does not establish chosen-family solidarity.

qualities.name: Reluctant alliance
qualities.match_rule: People who distrust or oppose each other cooperate against a shared threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: Cooperation among willing allies without reluctance does not establish a reluctant alliance.

qualities.name: Contested leadership
qualities.match_rule: People disagree over who should lead and this affects the group's actions.
qualities.not_sufficient: A named leader without a challenge to their leadership does not establish contested leadership.

qualities.name: Charismatic coercion
qualities.match_rule: A persuasive leader uses personal influence to secure harmful obedience.
qualities.not_sufficient: A leader giving orders without persuasion through personal influence does not establish charismatic coercion.

qualities.name: Group conformity pressure
qualities.match_rule: A group pressures individuals to follow its beliefs or actions.
qualities.not_sufficient: Shared behaviour without pressure on individuals does not establish conformity pressure.

qualities.name: Scapegoating
qualities.match_rule: A group assigns blame to a person to avoid or simplify its own responsibility.
qualities.not_sufficient: Accurate blame without displacement of group responsibility does not establish scapegoating.

qualities.name: Outsider exclusion
qualities.match_rule: A person is excluded because they are treated as outside the group.
qualities.not_sufficient: Being alone by choice without group exclusion does not establish outsider exclusion.

qualities.name: Corrupting mentorship
qualities.match_rule: A mentor teaches or recruits a learner into harmful conduct.
qualities.not_sufficient: A learner acting badly without mentorship causing or teaching the conduct does not establish corrupting mentorship.

qualities.name: Competition for survival resources
qualities.match_rule: Characters compete over limited resources needed to survive.
qualities.not_sufficient: Ordinary rivalry over a reward not needed for survival does not establish this competition.

qualities.name: Mutual destruction pact
qualities.match_rule: Characters contemplate or pursue an agreement to destroy themselves along with a threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: An individual sacrifice without an agreement or shared plan does not establish a mutual destruction pact.

qualities.name: Morally compromised protagonist
qualities.match_rule: A protagonist engages in wrongdoing that compromises their moral position.
qualities.not_sufficient: Being endangered, flawed or disliked without depicted wrongdoing does not establish moral compromise.

qualities.name: Socially isolated protagonist
qualities.match_rule: A protagonist lacks social support while facing the story's conflict.
qualities.not_sufficient: Geographic remoteness with supportive companions does not establish social isolation.

qualities.name: Contested female agency
qualities.match_rule: A female character's ability to choose or act is challenged by another person or social structure.
qualities.not_sufficient: A practical obstacle without a challenge to her agency does not establish contested female agency.

qualities.name: Children protecting each other
qualities.match_rule: Children cooperate to protect one another from a threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: An adult protecting a child or children merely present together does not establish reciprocal child protection.

qualities.name: Cooperative problem-solving
qualities.match_rule: People collaborate to understand and respond to a threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: Merely occupying the same place without shared reasoning or coordinated response does not establish cooperative problem-solving.

qualities.name: Intimacy with a monster
qualities.match_rule: A person has an emotionally or physically intimate bond with a monstrous being.
qualities.not_sufficient: An encounter or attack without an intimate bond does not establish intimacy with a monster.

qualities.name: Practical creature effects
qualities.match_rule: Physical materials or practical mechanisms are used to realise creatures in the completed film.
qualities.not_sufficient: A release decade, effects budget, praise or an unused practical-effects plan does not establish the technique's use.

qualities.name: Prosthetic bodily transformation
qualities.match_rule: Prosthetics or makeup are used to realise bodily transformations in the completed film.
qualities.not_sufficient: Ordinary makeup or an injury in a synopsis without transformation effects does not establish prosthetic transformation.

qualities.name: Digitally created creatures
qualities.match_rule: Digital effects are used to realise creatures in the completed film.
qualities.not_sufficient: Digital editing or colour grading without digitally realised creatures does not establish this quality.

qualities.name: Puppetry or animatronics
qualities.match_rule: Puppets or animatronics are used to realise a character or creature in the completed film.
qualities.not_sufficient: A prop with no puppet or animatronic performance, or an unused plan, does not establish this technique.

qualities.name: Stop-motion horror imagery
qualities.match_rule: Stop-motion animation is used in the completed film's horror imagery.
qualities.not_sufficient: A model or a claim that animation was considered does not establish completed stop-motion imagery.

qualities.name: Animated horror presentation
qualities.match_rule: Animation is used as a medium for presenting the film's horror narrative.
qualities.not_sufficient: A drawn object appearing in a live-action scene does not alone establish animated narrative presentation.

qualities.name: Black-and-white imagery
qualities.match_rule: The completed film uses black-and-white imagery.
qualities.not_sufficient: A monochrome poster, still photograph or unmade release plan does not establish black-and-white film imagery.

qualities.name: Expressionist production design
qualities.match_rule: Distorted sets or visual spaces create an expressionist presentation.
qualities.not_sufficient: A strange location without supported visual distortion or expressionist treatment does not establish expressionist design.

qualities.name: Concealment in shadow
qualities.match_rule: Shadow conceals a threat or visual information from the audience.
qualities.not_sufficient: A dark scene without concealment of the threat or information does not establish this device.

qualities.name: Extended takes
qualities.match_rule: The completed film uses shots described as unusually long and uninterrupted.
qualities.not_sufficient: A long scene, long story duration or a long rough cut does not establish extended takes.

qualities.name: Handheld camerawork
qualities.match_rule: The completed film uses handheld camerawork.
qualities.not_sufficient: A camera carried by a character in the story or an abandoned filming plan does not establish actual handheld cinematography.

qualities.name: Degraded recording texture
qualities.match_rule: The image or recording is presented with degraded or low-fidelity texture.
qualities.not_sufficient: A damaged viewing copy or low-budget production alone does not establish a texture used in the film's presentation.

qualities.name: First-person camera perspective
qualities.match_rule: The camera presents events as a character's direct visual perspective.
qualities.not_sufficient: A film following one character without optical point-of-view shots does not establish first-person camera perspective.

qualities.name: Minimal dialogue
qualities.match_rule: The completed film is described as using little dialogue.
qualities.not_sufficient: A synopsis with little quoted dialogue does not establish that the film uses little dialogue.

qualities.name: Sound-driven unease
qualities.match_rule: Specific sound design is described or reported as producing unease or dread.
qualities.not_sufficient: A frightening plot event without sound-design evidence does not establish sound-driven unease.

qualities.name: Dissonant musical tension
qualities.match_rule: Dissonance in the score is linked in the supplied account to tension or unease.
qualities.not_sufficient: Music being present or loud without dissonance linked to tension does not establish this quality.

qualities.name: Expressive silence
qualities.match_rule: Silence in the completed film is described as shaping suspense or emotional effect.
qualities.not_sufficient: Characters not speaking without evidence of silence in the soundtrack does not establish expressive silence.

qualities.name: Sudden startle effects
qualities.match_rule: Abrupt sensory changes are used for startling scares.
qualities.not_sufficient: A sudden narrative revelation alone does not establish a sensory startle effect.

qualities.name: Graphic bodily injury
qualities.match_rule: The completed film presents bodily injury or gore explicitly.
qualities.not_sufficient: An injury occurring in the story without presentation detail does not establish on-screen graphicness.

qualities.name: Implied violence
qualities.match_rule: Violence is suggested through sound, reactions or other cues rather than directly shown.
qualities.not_sufficient: A synopsis omitting an act does not establish that the film leaves it off screen.

qualities.name: Prolonged suffering
qualities.match_rule: The presentation dwells on suffering or torture over an extended interval.
qualities.not_sufficient: A character suffering for years in story time without extended presentation does not establish prolonged on-screen suffering.

qualities.name: Sexual violence
qualities.match_rule: Sexual assault or coercive sexual harm occurs in the story.
qualities.not_sufficient: Consensual sex or nonsexual violence alone does not establish sexual violence.

qualities.name: Harm to animals
qualities.match_rule: An animal is harmed or killed within the story's events.
qualities.not_sufficient: A dangerous animal or a threat not carried out does not establish harm to animals.

qualities.name: Children in danger
qualities.match_rule: A child faces a threat of physical harm within the story.
qualities.not_sufficient: Concern for a child actor during production or an adult described as childlike does not establish a child character in danger.

qualities.name: Physical action spectacle
qualities.match_rule: Chases, stunts or physical combat are presented as kinetic spectacle.
qualities.not_sufficient: A fight mentioned in a synopsis without action-presentation detail does not establish action spectacle.

qualities.name: Sustained dread
qualities.match_rule: The film's tone or an attributed response is described as an ongoing feeling of impending danger.
qualities.not_sufficient: One frightening event without a continuing apprehensive tone does not establish sustained dread.

qualities.name: Abrupt shock
qualities.match_rule: The film's presentation or an attributed response involves a sudden shocking disruption.
qualities.not_sufficient: A rapid event without a shocking presentation or attributed response does not establish abrupt shock.

qualities.name: Disgust and revulsion
qualities.match_rule: The film's presentation or an attributed response is described in terms of disgust or revulsion.
qualities.not_sufficient: A disgusting object in a synopsis without presentation or response evidence does not establish a disgust register.

qualities.name: Bleakness and nihilism
qualities.match_rule: The film's tone or outlook is described as bleak, nihilistic or despairing.
qualities.not_sufficient: A character suffering without evidence of a bleak tone or nihilistic outlook does not establish this quality.

qualities.name: Melancholy
qualities.match_rule: The film's emotional register is described as sorrowful or wistful.
qualities.not_sufficient: A sad event alone without tonal description does not establish melancholy.

qualities.name: Anxious uncertainty
qualities.match_rule: Uncertainty about events or identities creates anxious tension in the supplied account.
qualities.not_sufficient: Missing source information without described uncertainty or tension in the film does not establish anxious uncertainty.

qualities.name: Oppressive claustrophobia
qualities.match_rule: Confinement is described as creating an oppressive or claustrophobic experience.
qualities.not_sufficient: Enclosed rooms without an oppressive presentation or attributed response do not establish this effect.

qualities.name: Uncanny familiarity
qualities.match_rule: Something recognisably familiar is presented as disturbingly strange.
qualities.not_sufficient: An unfamiliar creature or ordinary familiar object without estrangement does not establish uncanny familiarity.

qualities.name: Dreamlike atmosphere
qualities.match_rule: The film's atmosphere is described as dreamlike or unreal.
qualities.not_sufficient: A character sleeping or a dream mentioned in a synopsis alone does not establish a dreamlike atmosphere.

qualities.name: Hallucinatory intensity
qualities.match_rule: The film's sensory presentation is described as hallucinatory or perceptually overwhelming.
qualities.not_sufficient: A character hallucinating in the story without sensory-presentation evidence does not establish hallucinatory intensity.

qualities.name: Dread of inevitability
qualities.match_rule: The film presents or evokes a sense that a feared outcome cannot be prevented.
qualities.not_sufficient: An adverse event occurring without a sense of inevitability does not establish dread of inevitability.

qualities.name: Playful camp
qualities.match_rule: The film's tone uses theatrical excess or knowingly artificial playfulness.
qualities.not_sufficient: Visible artifice or an audience laughing unintentionally alone does not establish playful camp.

qualities.name: Absurd humour
qualities.match_rule: Illogical or absurd situations are treated as humour.
qualities.not_sufficient: Unexplained events without comic treatment do not establish absurd humour.

qualities.name: Black comedy
qualities.match_rule: Death, suffering or taboo subjects receive darkly comic treatment.
qualities.not_sufficient: Death or a taboo appearing without comic treatment does not establish black comedy.

qualities.name: Satirical ridicule
qualities.match_rule: The film uses ridicule to criticise a social target or institution.
qualities.not_sufficient: Comedy without a target of criticism does not establish satirical ridicule.

qualities.name: Exuberant splatter
qualities.match_rule: Graphic bodily destruction is presented or reported as exuberant spectacle.
qualities.not_sufficient: Gore without exuberant presentation or an attributed exuberant response does not establish this tone.

qualities.name: Action exhilaration
qualities.match_rule: Physical action is presented or reported as exciting or exhilarating.
qualities.not_sufficient: Action events without presentation or attributed excitement do not establish action exhilaration.

qualities.name: Contemplative quiet
qualities.match_rule: Quiet scenes or presentation invite reflection or are described as contemplative.
qualities.not_sufficient: Little dialogue without reflective presentation does not establish contemplative quiet.

qualities.name: Dark fairy-tale atmosphere
qualities.match_rule: Fairy-tale-like wonder, logic or imagery is combined with menace.
qualities.not_sufficient: A fairy-tale reference without a menacing fairy-tale treatment does not establish this atmosphere.

qualities.name: Tragic pathos
qualities.match_rule: A character's downfall is framed or described in a way that invites sorrow.
qualities.not_sufficient: A death without sympathetic or sorrowful framing does not establish tragic pathos.

qualities.name: Tenderness amid horror
qualities.match_rule: Emotional gentleness or care is portrayed alongside horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: A character helping for purely instrumental reasons without tenderness does not establish this tone.

qualities.name: Moral discomfort
qualities.match_rule: Compromised choices or complicity are presented or reported as morally unsettling.
qualities.not_sufficient: Wrongdoing without morally unsettling framing or an attributed response does not establish moral discomfort.

qualities.name: Deliberate provocation
qualities.match_rule: The film confronts taboos or boundaries in a way described as deliberately provocative.
qualities.not_sufficient: A taboo topic's presence alone or an unused intention does not establish provocative treatment.

qualities.name: Otherworldly awe
qualities.match_rule: An encounter beyond ordinary experience is linked to awe or wonder.
qualities.not_sufficient: A supernatural encounter without awe or wonder in its presentation or attributed response does not establish this quality.

qualities.name: Cynical outlook
qualities.match_rule: The film's outlook presents human motives or institutions through distrust or disillusionment.
qualities.not_sufficient: One dishonest character without cynical framing does not establish a cynical outlook.

qualities.name: Unresolved identity at the ending
qualities.match_rule: A character's identity or nature remains unresolved at the film's conclusion.
qualities.not_sufficient: An incomplete source account or unknown background detail does not establish an unresolved character identity at the ending.

qualities.name: Unresolved threat at the ending
qualities.match_rule: Whether a threat has ended remains unresolved at the film's conclusion.
qualities.not_sufficient: A source omitting the outcome does not establish that the film leaves the threat unresolved.

qualities.name: Bittersweet survival
qualities.match_rule: Survival is achieved alongside loss that qualifies the outcome as bittersweet.
qualities.not_sufficient: Survival or loss alone without a mixed positive and sorrowful outcome does not establish bittersweet survival.

qualities.name: Costly self-sacrifice
qualities.match_rule: A character deliberately incurs grave personal cost to protect another or contain danger in the resolution.
qualities.not_sufficient: Accidental loss or help without self-incurred grave cost does not establish costly self-sacrifice.

qualities.name: Catastrophic defeat
qualities.match_rule: The resolution establishes a major victory for the threat or destruction of the protagonists' aims.
qualities.not_sufficient: A setback before the resolution or a limited loss without catastrophic defeat does not establish this outcome.

qualities.name: Decisive victory
qualities.match_rule: The resolution clearly establishes defeat of the threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: Apparent destruction with explicitly unresolved survival of the threat does not establish decisive victory.

qualities.name: Temporary containment
qualities.match_rule: The ending limits the threat without establishing its permanent elimination.
qualities.not_sufficient: Merely not knowing whether the threat survives does not establish containment.

qualities.name: Coexistence with the threat
qualities.match_rule: The ending establishes ongoing accommodation with a remaining threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: A threat's survival without accommodation does not establish coexistence.

qualities.name: Breaking an inherited cycle
qualities.match_rule: The resolution refuses or interrupts a harmful pattern passed between generations.
qualities.not_sufficient: A one-off danger ending without an inherited pattern does not establish breaking an inherited cycle.

qualities.name: Continuation of the cycle
qualities.match_rule: The resolution establishes that a harmful pattern continues or begins again.
qualities.not_sufficient: A surviving entity without an established continuation of harmful behaviour does not establish a continuing cycle.

qualities.name: Moral refusal
qualities.match_rule: In the resolution a character refuses a tempting choice that would harm others or violate their commitments.
qualities.not_sufficient: Avoiding an unwanted option without temptation or moral conflict does not establish moral refusal.

qualities.name: Ironic punishment
qualities.match_rule: The resolution links a character's downfall to the desire or wrongdoing that motivated them.
qualities.not_sufficient: A character's misfortune without a connection to their desire or wrongdoing does not establish ironic punishment.

qualities.name: Relationship reconciliation
qualities.match_rule: A damaged relationship is repaired in the resolution.
qualities.not_sufficient: People surviving together without repair of their relationship does not establish reconciliation.

qualities.name: Hopeful renewal
qualities.match_rule: The ending presents recovery or a positive new beginning after the threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: The ending merely stopping without a supported prospect of renewal does not establish hopeful renewal.

qualities.name: Morally ambiguous outcome
qualities.match_rule: The ending leaves competing moral evaluations of characters' choices unresolved.
qualities.not_sufficient: Uncertainty only about events or identity without competing moral readings does not establish moral ambiguity.

qualities.name: Humans are the real monsters
qualities.match_rule: Human cruelty is framed as more monstrous than, or as the horror underlying, an apparent nonhuman threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: A human antagonist or cruel act without this comparative moral framing does not establish humans as the real monsters.

qualities.name: Sympathy for the monster
qualities.match_rule: The film frames its monstrous figure with understanding or compassion.
qualities.not_sufficient: A tragic origin without sympathetic framing does not establish sympathy for the monster.

qualities.name: Innocence offers no protection
qualities.match_rule: The narrative presents moral innocence as failing to protect people against horrific harm.
qualities.not_sufficient: An innocent victim without a connection between innocence and the lack of protection does not establish this outlook.

qualities.name: Victim agency and resistance
qualities.match_rule: Threatened characters make choices and act to resist the danger they face.
qualities.not_sufficient: Suffering without choices or actions resisting the threat does not establish victim agency and resistance.

qualities.name: Competent people overwhelmed
qualities.match_rule: Characters are defeated or gravely endangered despite demonstrably capable responses.
qualities.not_sufficient: Job titles or claimed expertise without capable action do not establish competence under threat.

qualities.name: Avoidable foolishness drives disaster
qualities.match_rule: Repeatedly avoidable choices cause disaster or increase danger.
qualities.not_sufficient: One hindsight mistake, missing information or unavoidable panic alone does not establish this recurring pattern.

qualities.name: Villain-centred identification
qualities.match_rule: The narrative gives intimate access to or alignment with a perpetrator's experience.
qualities.not_sufficient: Showing an antagonist or revealing a plan alone does not establish narrative identification with them.

qualities.name: Violence with lasting consequences
qualities.match_rule: The film depicts continuing physical, psychological or relational effects of violence.
qualities.not_sufficient: An injury or death without subsequent effects being portrayed does not establish attention to lasting consequences.

qualities.name: Everyday cruelty
qualities.match_rule: Ordinary recognisable abuse or humiliation is presented as a source of horror independent of extraordinary threats.
qualities.not_sufficient: A rude remark without abusive, humiliating or horrific framing does not establish everyday cruelty as used here.

qualities.name: Inescapable institutional power
qualities.match_rule: A harmful institution constrains escape, redress and individual resistance.
qualities.not_sufficient: One ineffective official without institutional constraints does not establish inescapable institutional power.

qualities.name: Conditional family belonging
qualities.match_rule: A family makes belonging or acceptance conditional on obedience, identity or conformity.
qualities.not_sufficient: Family conflict without a condition on acceptance does not establish conditional belonging.

qualities.name: Rational explanation for apparent supernatural events
qualities.match_rule: The resolution explains apparently supernatural events through ordinary human or natural causes.
qualities.not_sufficient: One suggested natural explanation with a competing supernatural explanation left viable does not establish a resolved rational explanation.

qualities.name: Unresolved psychological or supernatural reading
qualities.match_rule: The film leaves both psychological and supernatural explanations of events viable.
qualities.not_sufficient: An unexplained creature or an incomplete source account without two viable readings does not establish this ambiguity.

qualities.name: Supernatural evil treated as real
qualities.match_rule: Supernatural evil is established as an actual force within the story's world.
qualities.not_sufficient: A character's belief, metaphor or unresolved apparition alone does not establish supernatural evil as real in the story.

qualities.name: Religion as protection
qualities.match_rule: Faith or religious practice provides protection or resistance against the threat.
qualities.not_sufficient: Religious imagery or belief without a protective effect does not establish religion as protection.

qualities.name: Religion as an instrument of abuse
qualities.match_rule: Religious authority or doctrine enables coercion, exploitation or abuse.
qualities.not_sufficient: A villain's religious identity or a dangerous god alone does not establish religion being used as an instrument of abuse.

qualities.name: Monstrosity as liberation
qualities.match_rule: Becoming or embracing the monstrous is presented as release from oppressive constraints.
qualities.not_sufficient: Transformation or increased power without liberatory framing does not establish monstrosity as liberation.

qualities.name: Revenge corrupts the avenger
qualities.match_rule: Pursuing revenge erodes an avenger's moral commitments or harms those they sought to protect.
qualities.not_sufficient: Violent retaliation without erosion of commitments or harm to protected people does not establish corruption of the avenger.

qualities.name: Forgiveness with responsibility
qualities.match_rule: The resolution offers forgiveness while acknowledging wrongdoing or its consequences.
qualities.not_sufficient: Forgetting or denying harm without acknowledgment does not establish forgiveness with responsibility.

qualities.name: Restoration over retribution
qualities.match_rule: The resolution chooses repairing harm over inflicting punishment.
qualities.not_sufficient: A nonviolent ending without a choice favouring repair over punishment does not establish restoration over retribution.

qualities.name: Redemption through action
qualities.match_rule: A morally compromised character acts to repair harm they previously caused.
qualities.not_sufficient: An apology, sympathetic biography or unrelated heroic act without repair does not establish redemption through action.

qualities.name: Hope through solidarity
qualities.match_rule: Mutual support is presented as a source of hope against the horror.
qualities.not_sufficient: Tactical cooperation without hopeful framing does not establish hope through solidarity.

qualities.name: Self-aware horror conventions
qualities.match_rule: The narrative recognises and plays with horror storytelling conventions as conventions.
qualities.not_sufficient: A familiar trope or audience recognition without in-film self-awareness does not establish this quality.

qualities.name: Affectionate genre play
qualities.match_rule: The film treats recognisable horror traditions with playful affection.
qualities.not_sufficient: References or parody without affectionate treatment do not establish affectionate genre play.

qualities.name: Fear of being disbelieved
qualities.match_rule: Others' failure to believe a threatened character increases that character's danger or isolation.
qualities.not_sufficient: An ignored statement without an effect on danger or isolation does not establish this dynamic.

qualities.name: Exploitation of vulnerability
qualities.match_rule: Someone exploits another person's dependency, illness or diminished capacity.
qualities.not_sufficient: A vulnerable person being present or harmed without their vulnerability being exploited does not establish this mechanism.
